rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying something happens sometimes but not always.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 si4 wui5 hai2 uk1 kei2 zyu2 faan6

rows.note: Use this when you mean occasionally or at intervals rather than as a general contrast with always.

example.english: It sometimes rains heavily, so remember to bring an umbrella.
example.jyutping: gaan1 zung1 lok6 daai6 jyu5 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1
